avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may reduce nebivolol levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; select alternative herbal supplement

avoid_supplements.name: Yohimbine
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Alpha-2 antagonist activity counteracts beta-blocker effects; risk of hypertension and tachycardia

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May increase blood pressure and heart rate, potentially opposing nebivolol effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate; discuss with prescriber if used

caution_supplements.name: Licorice
caution_supplements.mechanism: Can elevate blood pressure and cause sodium retention, counteracting beta-blocker benefits
caution_supplements.action: Limit intake; monitor blood pressure regularly

caution_supplements.name: Hawthorn
caution_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate cardiovascular effects; additive hypotensive and inotropic effects possible
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor heart rate and blood pressure

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Excess sodium may reduce antihypertensive efficacy of nebivolol
caution_foods.action: Maintain moderate sodium intake (<2,300 mg/day) as part of heart disease management

monitoring_notes: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, and signs of bronchospasm or fatigue. CYP2D6 poor metabolizers may accumulate nebivolol; dosage adjustment may be warranted. Avoid abrupt discontinuation due to risk of rebound hypertension.
